title: Goal Coupling
hook: Six projects going and somehow none of them move the main thing.
statement: Every smaller goal should line up under one bigger purpose.
explainer: Being busy feels like progress. But when projects point in different directions, they cancel each other out. Time is your scarcest resource, so aim it.
sop: Write your core mission in one sentence.
List every project, habit, and commitment taking up your time.
Score each one's Relevance to Main Goal from 1 to 10.
Add them up to see how aligned you really are.
Drop or renegotiate anything scoring under 4.
equation_example: Project A scores 8, B scores 3, C scores 6. 8 + 3 + 6 = 17 out of a possible 30. Higher means your effort actually points at your goal. Lower means you're busy going nowhere in particular.
question: Name one commitment on your calendar that doesn't serve your main goal at all.
closing_statement: Every commitment should trace back to one destination.
caption:
Principle Nº 200: Goal Coupling

Six projects going and somehow none of them move the main thing.

Every smaller goal should line up under one bigger purpose.

Your turn: Name one commitment on your calendar that doesn't serve your main goal at all.
